description: Turns a finished Form 1040 package into a narrated plain-English video summary for the client, verified line by line against the return, approved by the preparer, delivered by download.
_doc: In-tree manifest for KisaesDevLab/Vibe-Recap. THREE containers plus a migration one-shot, from three GHCR images: `vibe-recap-api` (Fastify, 3000; also the migration and seed one-shots), `vibe-recap-web` (nginx serving the React UI, 80), `vibe-recap-worker` (Python: extraction, script, verifier, Kokoro narration, Playwright slides, ffmpeg). NETWORK POSTURE: the worker never joins vibe_net. It lives on a private internal network behind `vibe-recap-relay`, a socat container that forwards exactly four ports (postgres 5432, redis 6379, vibe-ai-router 8220, vibellm 11434) and carries those names as aliases so the shared env file works unchanged; the worker therefore has no internet route on the appliance either. ROUTER: script generation goes through vibe-ai-router by default (task class `recap_script`, registered by the api at startup and starting local_only until the firm admin widens it). Unlike Vibe-1040 the router is not fatal - with an empty token the app falls back to the appliance's local model server through OLLAMA_URL - but the token is minted at enable like every other app, hence requiredApps. OCR of scanned pages needs an Ollama-native endpoint (`/api/chat` with images); if vibellm only speaks /v1 the job fails cleanly at `ocr` and the preparer asks for a text-layer PDF. MIGRATIONS: the api honours MIGRATIONS_AUTO; the appliance sets it false and runs `migrate` as the one-shot in the overlay (idempotent) and at update time. FIRST LOGIN: `seed-admin` creates the first admin from SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL / SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD, is a no-op once any user exists, and the app's /setup page disables itself as soon as a user exists.

required.name: ALLOWED_ORIGIN
required.doc: Comma-separated list accepted. State-changing browser requests must carry one of these origins.

required.name: DATA_DIR
required.doc: Encrypted blob store, master key, form profiles, orphans. Bind-mounted from /opt/vibe/data/apps/vibe-recap and shared by api and worker (both uid 1000, hence dataOwner).

required.name: VIBE_AI_ROUTER_URL
required.doc: The router's /v1 gateway on vibe_net; the worker reaches it through vibe-recap-relay under the same name. Never through Caddy.

required.name: VIBE_AI_TOKEN
required.doc: App token minted against the vibe-ai-router admin API during enable and preserved across re-renders. Empty token = scripts are generated on the local model server instead.

required.name: OLLAMA_URL
required.doc: Ollama-native endpoint used for the local-provider fallback and for OCR of scanned pages. On the appliance this is the local model server, reached by the worker through the relay.

required.name: MIGRATIONS_AUTO
required.doc: The appliance runs migrations explicitly (overlay one-shot at enable, update.sh at update).

required.name: LICENSE_ENFORCE
required.doc: Kisaes licensing check stays informational until the licensing server is live (Vibe-Recap QUESTIONS.md Q35).

required.name: SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD
required.doc: First-login password for the admin the seed step creates. Surfaced in the First-login card and CREDENTIALS.txt; preserved across re-renders.

optional.name: VIBE_APP_SUBDOMAIN
optional.doc: Operator override for this app's subdomain label. Empty = the manifest default (recap). Single DNS label.

ui.label: Subdomain
ui.helpText: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.<your-domain> for this app. Leave blank for the default. Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes; no dots.

optional.name: SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL
optional.doc: Login for the first admin created by the seed step. Set it BEFORE first enable; the seed is a no-op once any user exists.

ui.label: First admin email
ui.helpText: The email you sign in with the first time. Set it before you enable the app.

optional.name: OLLAMA_MODEL
optional.doc: Model used when scripts are generated locally (Settings > General > provider = Bundled Ollama, or no router token).

ui.label: Local script model
ui.helpText: Ollama model name on the local model server for the local-provider fallback. The router provider ignores this.

optional.name: OLLAMA_OCR_MODEL
optional.doc: Ollama-native vision model used to OCR scanned pages when a return has no text layer.

ui.label: OCR model
ui.helpText: Needs an Ollama-native endpoint. If your local model server only speaks the OpenAI API, scanned packages fail cleanly at the OCR step.

optional.name: OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_S
optional.doc: Seconds one script attempt may take (router or local). CPU-only boxes need minutes.

ui.label: Script model timeout (s)
ui.helpText: One attempt at writing the narration script. 600 is safe on CPU-only hardware.

optional.name: WORKER_CONCURRENCY
optional.doc: Recap jobs processed at once. Keep 1 unless the host has spare cores and RAM (each job renders a video).

ui.label: Concurrent recap jobs
ui.helpText: 1 is right for a 6-core box. Takes effect when the worker restarts.

optional.name: MASTER_KEY_PASSPHRASE
optional.doc: Optional passphrase wrapping /data/keys/master.key. If set, it must be present at every start. Leave empty on the appliance; /opt/vibe/env is inside the sealed backup set already.

optional.name: TZ
optional.doc: IANA time zone; inherits the appliance-wide TZ unless overridden.

firstLogin.note: The username is whatever SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL was at enable time. Change the password under your account after signing in; the seed never resets it. Served at the root of its own subdomain in both routing modes (rootServedOnly); in LAN/Tailscale mode use http://<server-ip>:5183/.

seed.description: Creates the first admin from SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL / SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD. No demo data. No-op once any user exists.
